{{recipesummary|category=Pie and tart recipes
| Yield = 2 pies|time=2 hours (with pre-prepared crusts)|difficulty=3
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 3 cups white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]], divided
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], well-beaten
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]

==Procedure==

# Wash and clean raisins and add the cold water and 1½ cups of sugar.
# Cook until the raisins are tender and plump. 
# Set aside to cool.
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|440°F]].
# Mix the flour, 1½ cups of sugar, and the shortening, [[cookbook:Crumble|crumbling]] well with the fingers. Take out 1 cup of these crumbs and set aside.
# To the remaining crumb mixture, add the eggs and milk; mix well.
# Stir in the baking powder.
# Line 2 large [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie tins]] with [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie crust]] and fill with cooked raisins. Pour over this the batter and sprinkle the top with the cup of reserved crumbs.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] in a hot oven at 440°F for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to moderate oven (350°F) and finish baking, about 35 minutes.
